about: The SQL Server half of the error mapping (ADR 0019): each of the core's neutral error classes to SQL Server's error number, severity, state and message, and how far the error reaches. 'ends' is statement (the next statement of the batch runs), scope (the rest of the procedure, function or trigger does not, and its caller goes on) or batch (nothing after it runs). 'catchable_at_same_level' is false for an error that a TRY beside the failing statement does not catch but the TRY of a caller does. Every entry was decided against SQL Server in the sandbox (tests/test_error_mapping_sqlserver.py). The delivered project carries this file as error-mapping.json.

Arithmetic overflow error converting {from_type:type} to data type numeric.

variants.fallback_message: Conversion failed when converting a text value to a whole number.
Error converting a text value to a whole number.

variants.fallback_message: Error converting a text value to an exact number.

nesting_level_exceeded.message: Maximum stored procedure, function, trigger, or view nesting level exceeded (limit 32).

variants.message: The COMMIT TRANSACTION request has no corresponding BEGIN TRANSACTION.

savepoint_not_found.message: Cannot roll back {name}. No transaction or savepoint of that name was found.

raise_argument_mismatch.message: The data type of substitution parameter {index} does not match the expected type of the format specification.
